name: ZeroTok Research
tagline: Send a Shopify domain, get back a competitor report: revenue, traffic, ads.
description: Competitive research for storefronts on Shopify: hand over a domain and a report comes back covering estimated revenue, traffic levels, which products sell best, plus the advertising currently running. It is a quick read on how a rival store is doing, without assembling the picture from several dashboards yourself.
author: cu30rry_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
